answer: In each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake and commits to a rate-limited polynomial over a Semaphore identity tree. Every message carries a zero-knowledge proof and polynomial evaluation; meadow, atlas, and raven are merely domain labels. If duplicate messaging reuses a nullifier beyond the permitted rate, the resulting evaluations enable Shamir reconstruction of the concealed private key, producing cryptographic evidence for instantaneous, verifiable collateral slashing.
